response.text: The dictionary says APINVH has status V (void), but none appear in the data. Let me check the sign conventions, the balance of journals, and the join paths between tables.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'jrnl_balance' chk, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(d-c)>0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unbalanced, MIN(d) min_dr, MAX(d) max_dr FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("DR_AMT") d, SUM("CR_AMT") c FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO") x UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_inv_vs_jrnl_hdr', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN h."JRNL_NO" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), NULL, NULL FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_gljrnl_lines', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_paid_sum_mismatch', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) paid FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT") z WHERE i_mismatch(z) IS NULL;

SELECT i."STAT_CD", COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.paid,0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_pay, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(p.paid,0)-i."INV_AMT")<0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fully_paid, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.paid,0)>i."INV_AMT"+0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overpaid FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN (SELECT "INV_ID", SUM("PAY_AMT") paid FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY "INV_ID") p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."STAT_CD";

SELECT h."SRC_CD", h."POST_FLG", COUNT(DISTINCT h."JRNL_NO") journals, MIN(h."POST_DT") min_dt, MAX(h."POST_DT") max_dt, MIN(h."PRD_ID") min_prd, MAX(h."PRD_ID") max_prd, SUM(CASE WHEN h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_ref FROM "GLJRNH" h GROUP BY h."SRC_CD", h."POST_FLG";
